title: 🏥 Fargo ND Healthcare Jobs: Multiple Travel & Local Roles Open - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Fargo’s healthcare scene is busy and growing, with lots of options if you’re open to travel contracts or specialty roles. Here are several solid openings worth a look this week.
Travel Speech Language Pathologist - Full-Time Employer: Affinity Home Health Care Inc Location: Fargo, ND (Skilled Nursing Facility) Type: Full-time, Travel SLP Schedule: ~ 36 hours/week Why it’s interesting: SNF-focused role with an 88–90% productivity target, complimentary housing and travel , licensing and malpractice coverage, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k), and support from a personal recruiter. Travel Physical Therapist - Full-Time Employer: Health Wealth Safe Location: Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Travel PT Schedule: 36 hours/week , 12-hour day shifts Why it’s interesting: Hands-on PT role with personalized care plans, medical coverage, housing support, license reimbursement , referral bonuses, and continuing education opportunities. Nurse Manager - NICU Employer: Sanford Health Location: Sanford Medical Center Fargo, Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Leadership RN Schedule: 8-hour day shifts, 40 hours/week Why it’s interesting: Lead a Level IV, 40-bed regional referral NICU in a Magnet-recognized children’s hospital, with a neonatal flight team and micropreemie program. Includes comprehensive benefits , 401(k), and generous PTO. Travel Physical Therapist - Weekly Pay Employer: Aura Health Location: Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Travel PT Schedule: 12-hour day shifts Why it’s interesting: General therapy travel role with focus on rehab, accurate documentation, and collaboration. Highlights include weekly pay and a flexible, fast-paced environment. Travel Physical Therapist - Weekly Pay Employer: Fairview Hospital / Cleveland Clinic Location: Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Travel PT Why it’s interesting: PT travel assignment with a big-name system, focused on detailed assessments, evidence-based treatment, and patient education. Emphasizes strong clinical skills, BLS, and teamwork. RN Traveler - Med Surge Resource Team Employer: Sanford Health – Solutions By Sanford Location: Sanford Broadway Med Ctr, Fargo, ND Type: Part-time, Travel RN (Med Surg Resource) Schedule: 12-hour rotating shifts, 36 hours/week , 14-week contracts Pay Info: Listed weekly pay ~2812 (includes stipend) Why it’s interesting: Travel-style role within Sanford with weekly pay, stipend included, Sanford benefits , and option to extend or move to another Sanford site. Requires RN experience plus prior travel experience. RN Traveler - ICU Resource Team Employer: Sanford Health – Solutions By Sanford Location: Sanford Broadway Med Ctr, Fargo, ND Type: Part-time, Travel RN (ICU Resource) Schedule: 12-hour night shifts, 36 hours/week , 14-week contracts Pay Info: Listed weekly pay ~2830 (includes stipend) Why it’s interesting: Night-shift ICU travel contract with weekly pay, full Sanford benefits , and built-in flexibility across Sanford sites. Great fit for experienced ICU travelers living 60+ miles away. Local Contract Respiratory Therapist - $53–57/hr Employer: Host Healthcare, Inc. Location: Fargo, ND Type: Local contract, Respiratory Therapist Pay: $53–57 per hour (estimated) Schedule: 13 weeks , 36 hours/week , 12-hour shifts (days or nights) Why it’s interesting: Higher hourly local contract with Day 1 medical, 401(k) match, housing support, travel reimbursements , and a long list of extra perks like pet insurance and wellness programs. Travel Speech Language Pathologist - $2,661/week Employer: HealthCare Support Location: Fargo, ND Type: Travel SLP Pay: $2,661 per week (based on 40 hrs) Schedule: 13 weeks , 40 hours/week , 8-hour shifts Why it’s interesting: Well-paid SLP travel role with license/cert reimbursement, medical, 401(k), weekly pay , and strong recruiter/clinical support throughout the assignment. Travel Operating Room RN - $2,603/week Employer: Medical Solutions Location: Fargo, ND Type: Travel RN – OR Pay: $2,603 per week (estimated, 40 hrs) Schedule: 13 weeks , 40 hours/week , 10-hour day shifts Why it’s interesting: OR travel contract with Day 1 medical/dental/vision, 401(k) with company contribution, paid private housing, per diem and travel pay , and strong recruiter support. Travel Speech Language Pathologist - $2,598/week Employer: Anders Group, LLC Location: Fargo, ND Type: Travel SLP Pay: $2,598 per week (based on 40 hrs) Schedule: 13 weeks , 40 hours/week , 8-hour day shifts Why it’s interesting: Travel SLP job with Day 1 health, dental, vision, 401(k) , plus license & CEU reimbursement, travel per diems, and referral bonuses. Travel Nurse RN - Med Surg - $2,400/week Employer: Cross Country Nurses Location: Fargo, ND Type: Travel RN – Med Surg Pay: $2,400 per week (estimated, 36 hrs) Schedule: 13 weeks , 36 hours/week , 12-hour shifts , every other weekend/holiday Why it’s interesting: Busy acute Med Surg unit in a large hospital/trauma center, with housing or housing allowance, health insurance, 401(k) , travel reimbursement, and unlimited free CE credits . Travel Speech Language Pathologist - Per Diem Employer: Health Marketing Location: Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Travel SLP (Per Diem pay structure) Why it’s interesting: Wide-ranging SLP caseload across communication and swallowing disorders with competitive pay, full insurance, PTO, 401(k) match, license reimbursement , and 24/7 support. Travel Speech Therapist - Weekly Pay Employer: Northshore Home Health Care Location: Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Travel SLP Why it’s interesting: Focused on speech, hearing, and swallowing with clear clinical expectations (master’s, CCCs, 1+ year experience). Weekly pay and travel-style setup. Travel Skilled Nursing Facility Occupational Therapist Employer: Health Wealth Safe Location: Fargo, ND (SNF) Type: Travel OT (Therapy) Schedule: 40 hours/week , 8-hour shifts Why it’s interesting: SNF OT travel role with medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement , plus license and relocation reimbursement and a quick interview-to-offer process . Travel Speech Language Pathologist - Weekly Pay Employer: Plan A Health Location: Fargo, ND (SNF) Type: Travel SLP Schedule: 8-hour day shifts, 40 hours/week Why it’s interesting: SNF SLP contract with focus on treatment planning and documentation, plus medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and referral bonuses . Travel Speech Therapist - Weekly Pay Employer: Provident Behavioral Health Location: Fargo, ND (Acute care setting) Type: Full-time, Travel SLP Why it’s interesting: Acute care SLP role (speech, language, swallowing) with ASHA certification and BLS required; open to newer grads with at least 6 months’ experience. Travel Speech Language Pathologist - Full-Time Employer: Northshore Home Health Care Location: Fargo, ND Type: Full-time, Travel SLP Why it’s interesting: Broad SLP role with strong focus on education and evidence-based care, plus competitive pay, comprehensive insurance, PTO, 401(k) match, bonuses, and CEU reimbursement . Interventional Cardiology Physician Employer: Health Wealth Safe Location: Fargo, ND Type: Temporary, Inpatient Cardiology Schedule: ~ 10 days/month (day & night call; flexible in 5–10 day blocks) Why it’s interesting: High-acuity inpatient role (caths, temp pacers, urgent echos, EP coverage) for a board-certified interventional cardiologist with TEEs and Epic experience. Ideal for someone wanting recurring locums-style work.
